We think that the gender-neutral moniker Bell would be perfect. Meaning “beautiful,” this English gem is a variation of the Hebrew name Isabel. When spending time with your little Bell, they won’t need all the bells and whistles; all they’ll need is your love, and they’ll return the favor by being a constant source of joy.On this page:Famous People Named BellPopularity Trend ChartRelated Baby Names ListsSibling Name IdeasNames with the Same MeaningFamous People Named BellWondering who else shares this name?
